github.com/makefunstuff/pairing-buddy
Pairing buddy is an AI pair programmer for Neovim.
Here are three moments from an ordinary day.
You edit the wrong file while a test is red.
Watch the margin.
You change the backoff.
Pair speaks once, under your line.
The real cause is in worker dot go.
Alt J goes there.
You fix one line, and save.
Watch the statusline, then the ghost text.
Pair runs your tests on every save.
A test that passed before now fails.
Alt J shows Pair’s fix as ghost text:
the old line struck through, the new one under it.
Alt Y takes it.
Save, and it’s green.
You hand Pair the wheel for one change.
Watch your code.
Pair drive, and say what you want.
It types where you can see it, tests the unsaved buffer, and hands back.
U undoes it all, in one step.
Pairing buddy.
The full tutorial, the docs and the code are on GitHub.
